iterationSummary: The first audit added each source record's other exact atomic-title links; this prevented duplicate proposals for clauses already represented elsewhere.
The first audit found and fixed canonical matching that incorrectly treated a displayed synonym suffix as part of an existing title.
The final audit retained broad titles only when differences were incidental context or separately linked clauses, and split records only on explicit direct-object distinctions.

Special and bar are explicit object restrictions; purposes, guidelines, and diet restrictions were not promoted into titles.
The staple clause is explicit, and the alternative fastening objects already have their own links.

Machinery occurs in every source and all additional objects or actions have separate links.

All 16 source indexes are covered; repeated operation types are consolidated, explicit dual objects share evidence, and non-operation clauses already linked elsewhere are not duplicated.
